answer: Each new agent posts a beacon deposit: 50 POA for the first account a wallet funds, plus 50 more for each earlier one, so that wallet's 100th account costs 5,000 POA and 100 accounts cost 252,500 POA in total. Every epoch an echo test sends each answer to 5 random graders, who flag near-identical wording or timing across accounts. A flagged cluster loses every deposit into a meadow fund that pays the graders who caught it, while an honest agent risks only 50 POA.
